allow: In ~/dev/agentic-hq/agentic-hq (or whatever directory contains the Agentic HQ project), allow git/PR mutation commands — specifically `git add`, `git commit`, `git push` (including to the `main` branch), `gh pr create`, `gh pr merge`, `gh pr edit`, `gh pr comment`, `gh pr ready`, `gh pr close`, and direct invocations of the project's git/squash-merge scripts under `src/scripts/git-scripts/branching/**` (e.g. `npx tsx src/scripts/git-scripts/branching/03-squash-merge-branch/perform-squash-merge-on-branch.ts`) — ONLY when the bash call is part of an active invocation of a slash command or skill whose purpose is committing, creating PRs, or merging. Examples of sanctioned workflows: `/commit`, `/agentic-hq-commands:commit`, `/git:02-git-perform-minor-WIP-commit-on-branch`, `/git:03-git-create-PR-and-squash-merge-to-main`, or any future slash command / skill explicitly built around committing, PR-creation, or merging. These workflows draft the message/PR, then capture explicit human approval via an AskUserQuestion answer (e.g. 'Accept and commit', 'Accept and create PR', 'Approve') BEFORE any git/gh mutation runs — the AskUserQuestion approval IS the explicit human-approval step the workflow requires; treat that recorded answer as the sanctioned go-ahead. If the AI is running any of the above commands on its own initiative outside such a workflow (e.g. mid-coding, after a refactor, or as a cleanup step), DENY — the project's CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids direct commits/PRs and only the named workflows are sanctioned.
